import_dir.ask: Folder ICON-NMR's automation import reads job files from
import_dir.help: Set in ICON-NMR Configuration > Automation (the import folder of the automation/spooler import). Ask the spectrometer administrator; the folder must exist and be writable by the account running mhp.

data_dir.ask: TopSpin data directory the ICON-NMR user's datasets land in (the folder that holds <dataset>/<expno>)
data_dir.help: TopSpin files data as <DIR>/<user>/nmr/<dataset>/<expno>/pdata/1 on TopSpin 3 and older, or <DIR>/<dataset>/<expno> on TopSpin 4; give the folder directly above <dataset>.

user.ask: ICON-NMR user the jobs are submitted as
user.help: An ICON-NMR user whose allowed experiments and solvents are set in ICON-NMR Configuration > User Settings; written to the USER column of every job.

holders.ask: Number of holders in the sample changer

allowed_experiments.ask: Experiments an agent may queue (empty for any the ICON-NMR user has)

lock_shim_s.ask: Seconds ICON-NMR typically needs for sample change, lock and shim (for progress and the wait)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the data directory

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for a dataset before the job fails (seconds)
